answer: Each identity runs one forge shop and locks a 70-credit bond. Each ferrous batch carries an umber seal binding its forge key and assay certificate. A lab samples one ingot, re-assays its ferrous content against the grade band; a mismatch, reused certificate, or moved seal burns the bond. The first shop pays 26 credits, the kth pays 26+6(k-1), so the 1000th pays 6020 and 1000 fake shops pay 3,023,000 plus 70,000 locked. An honest shop pays 26 once, refunded after a clean assay. A rented-furnace ring fails: a rented forge key cannot reproduce that seal-assay pairing.
